description: Source code for Android's SensorManager implementation in the sensorservice HAL, managing sensor data collection, event queues, and threading.

classes.name: SensorManager
classes.description: Implementation of the sensor service manager, handling sensor list retrieval, default sensors, direct channels, and event queues.

methods.name: getSensorList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available sensors.

methods.name: getDefaultSensor

methods.description: Creates a direct channel using ashmem memory.

methods.name: createGrallocDirectChannel

methods.name: createEventQueue
methods.description: Creates a new sensor event queue with a callback.
